stories.title: Mariota ruled out as Commanders turn to 7th-round rookie at QB
stories.summary: Marcus Mariota left Sunday's game against the Colts with a knee injury, forcing the Commanders to turn to seventh-round rookie Athan Kaliakmanis at quarterback.

stories.title: Eagles RT Johnson a surprise inactive due to personal reasons
stories.summary: Eagles right tackle Lane Johnson is inactive against the Rams for personal reasons.

stories.title: 'Totally unacceptable:' F1 drivers slam delayed start to Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia
stories.summary: "Horrible", "sad", and "totally unacceptable" were among the reactions of Formula 1's drivers to the sport's attempt at racing in wet conditions at Sunday's Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.

stories.title: Sources: LaPorta, Lions break off contract talks after negotiations stall
stories.summary: The Lions and star tight end Sam LaPorta have broken off contract talks, sources told NFL Network, after attempting to work out a long-term deal for the first few weeks of the season.

stories.title: Brewers escape as Padres' potential go-ahead HR hits roof, falls for out
stories.summary: The Brewers eked out a Game 1 NLDS win after the American Family Field roof impeded what the Padres thought was going to be a go-ahead home run in the ninth inning.
